title: Malaysian Tempeh Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy stir fry made with tempeh, inspired by Malaysian cuisine. Gluten-free and delicious!
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the tempeh and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Malaysian seasoning blend, garlic, and ginger, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the chili peppers and bok choy, and stir-fry until the vegetables are tender-crisp.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and hoisin sauce.
Pour the sauce over the tempeh and vegetables, and stir-fry for another minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over a bowl of steamed rice or noodles.
